protection.name: "Tikka" Disease / Leaf Spot Complex (Cercospora arachidicola - Early Leaf Spot; Phaeoisariopsis personata - Late Leaf Spot)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Heavy in Kharif and Summer)
protection.impact:
Early Leaf Spot: Circular reddish-brown to black spots with prominent bright yellow halos on upper leaf surfaces.

Late Leaf Spot: Small, circular, jet-black spots without yellow halos on both leaf surfaces; spots coalesce rapidly, leading to severe leaf necrosis, defoliation ("leaf drop"), and bare stems; reduces pod yield by 30–70%.
protection.passage: Groundnut — source table 158, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Groundnut Rust (Puccinia arachidis)
protection.geography: Warm, Dewy Post-Monsoon Belts (Heavy in South & Central India)
protection.impact: Orange-to-reddish-brown powdery pustules (uredinia) on the lower surface of leaves; corresponding upper surface shows chlorotic yellow flecks; pustules rupture, shedding powdery spores; infected leaves curl, become necrotic, and dry on the vine without dropping ("scorched appearance").
protection.passage: Groundnut — source table 158, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: White Grub (Holotrichia consanguinea, H. serrata)
protection.geography: Sandy Desert & Light Alluvial Soils (Devastating in Rajasthan, Gujarat, Haryana)
protection.impact: Adult beetles emerge from soil after pre-monsoon showers and mate on host trees; "C"-shaped fleshy white grubs feed underground on primary taproots, secondary rootlets, and developing pods; plants wilt, turn yellow, and die in large circular patches; damaged plants pull out effortlessly without roots.
protection.passage: Groundnut — source table 158, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Collar Rot / Crown Rot (Aspergillus niger)
protection.impact: Dark brown-to-black rotting of the hypocotyl and stem collar at the soil line; infected collar tissues become covered in a dense, powdery mass of jet-black fungal spores; seedlings topple over, wilt, and die within 10–20 days post-emergence.
protection.passage: Groundnut — source table 158, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Aflatoxin Contamination / Yellow Mold (Aspergillus flavus, A. parasiticus)
protection.impact: Pods colonized by soil mold during late-season moisture stress or damp curing; internal kernels develop yellow-green velvety fungal crusts; produces toxic, carcinogenic aflatoxins (); causes container rejection by overseas port authorities.
protection.passage: Groundnut — source table 158, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Groundnut Bruchid / Seed Beetle (Caryedon serratus) & Rust-Red Flour Beetle (Tribolium castaneum)
protection.impact: Bruchid grubs bore circular holes through tough in-shell pod walls, feeding internally on cotyledons; spin white papery cocoons partially protruding from the shell; stored kernels lose weight, free fatty acids (FFA) spike, and oil turns rancid.
protection.passage: Groundnut — source table 158, row 7. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
